title: drone-agriculture-forecast: bibliometric data and MATLAB growth-model pipeline for UAV research in agriculture

creators.name: Uroš, Vedran
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Organization and Informatics, University of Zagreb, Varaždin, Croatia

creators.name: Jelić, Marko
creators.affiliation: University of Applied Sciences "Marko Marulić" in Knin, Knin, Croatia

description: Annual OpenAlex counts (2005-2025) of articles combining UAV terms with agricultural terms, using a documented noise-filtered query, with normalising denominators and seven sub-domains, and a toolbox-free MATLAB pipeline fitting exponential, logistic, Gompertz and Bass growth models by Poisson deviance, comparing them with QAICc, backtesting them and producing negative-binomial bootstrap forecast intervals for 2028-2035, together with a sensitivity battery (saturating-models-only average, share analysis without 2025, three alternative denominators). Companion to the paper "Drones in Agriculture: Bibliometric State of the Art and Growth Forecasts to 2035" (MIPRO Robotics, RTA-DRONES) and to the drone-ecology-forecast repository (doi:10.5281/zenodo.22119199).
